hints.title: Non-Decreasing Edge Processing
hints.text: Sort the tree edges in ascending order of the maximum node value between the two endpoints.

hints.title: Disjoint Component Tracking
hints.text: Merge components incrementally using disjoint set union. Each component tracks its maximum value and how many nodes in the component attain that maximum value.

hints.title: Good Path Combination
hints.text: When uniting two components that share the same maximum value, the product of their maximum-value node counts gives the number of newly formed good paths.

hints.title: Disjoint Set Good Path Union Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting edges takes O(n log n); DSU operations with path compression run in near-linear O(n alpha(n)).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running breadth-first search from each node takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Component arrays maintain maximum values and occurrences per representative.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sorts edges by max value and connects components with disjoint set union to count paths.
